headline: OpenAI's own report says more than 40 million people use ChatGPT every day to ask health questions.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 2: the figure dates from January 2026, not new today.
importance_line: It shows how many patients now consult a chatbot before or instead of a doctor, but the figure is OpenAI's own and chatbots can give wrong answers.
summary: Healthcare Dive reports, citing an OpenAI report from early January 2026, that more than 40 million people use ChatGPT daily for health questions and that over 5% of all messages worldwide concern healthcare. Today's NewsBytes item repeats this older figure; the numbers are OpenAI's own and Healthcare Dive notes chatbots can give wrong or misleading answers.
notes: Older news re-dated; Healthcare Dive used in place of blocked NewsBytes.
